[Effects]

Increases physical and magic Ability Power by L.

[Activation Category]
Attack Awakening Constant Skill (up to 2 Constant Skills of the same category can be used at once).

[Activation Rate]
Constant

Increases ATK/MATK of Lances and Scythes by 35%.
